subject: Post-demo: candidate model recommendations, benchmarks & acceptance gates
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@finova.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@finova.com>
Date: 2027-07-26T14:05:00Z
Subject: Discovery: model fit needs and baseline metrics

Neha — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and what we need to validate in a short pilot: 

- Context: Finova runs an internal conversational assistant (customer-facing) powered by a proprietary model, FinovaNLP-v3. We want to evaluate open-model candidates as a potential cost/latency improvement while preserving answer quality for financial FAQs and KYC flows.
- Key acceptance gates (approx): intent accuracy >= 92%, NER F1 >= 90 (entities relevant to account onboarding), hallucination rate < 3% on a 500-sample prompt set, answer relevance (human eval) delta <= 5% vs baseline.
- Latency target: p95 inference < 150ms (US region), throughput 40 TPS typical.
- Data sharing: we can provide a redacted 2k prompt set (customer questions + expected labels) but cannot share PII.

Next asks:
1) Can you propose 2–3 open models to trial and what quantization/instance types you'd recommend?
2) What benchmark artifacts / prompt bundle will you need, and how long would a 2-week trial take?
3) Do you foresee any quality regression risks vs FinovaNLP-v3 we should be aware of?

Attaching a small sample prompt file for your reference.

—Jamie
Director of Product, Finova

Attachment: Finova_sample_prompts.csv (csv)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@finova.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-26T18:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery: model fit needs and baseline metrics

Jamie — great meeting, thanks for the clear acceptance gates. High-level answers below and next steps proposal.

Shortlist (open candidates) — recommended trial configs:
- Mistral-Instruct-34B (fp16 / q4_0): strong instruction-following, good cost/latency tradeoff for conversational workloads.
- Llama-2-Chat-70B (q4_K_M or q4_0 depending on early perf): higher quality on long-context but heavier; consider for safety-sensitive responses.
- Falcon-180B-Instruct (q8_0 on A100s): aggressive on generation quality but requires higher capacity; useful as an upper-bound comparator.

Quick notes on tradeoffs: Mistral-34B should hit your latency target on a well-provisioned instance (p95 ~ 120–140ms with continuous batching disabled). Llama-2-70B will likely be closer to 150–220ms depending on KV cache hits and instance SKU. Falcon-180B will exceed latency targets unless we use specialized GPUs and aggressive quantization.

Benchmark artifacts we need:
- Your 2k redacted prompt set + labels (CSV or JSONL)
- A short list of 30 high-risk prompts (where hallucination is business-critical)

Deliverables for a 2-week trial:
1) Day 0–2: ingest prompt bundle, configure model variants + quantization profiles, baseline FinovaNLP-v3 test run (if you can share inference logs or golden answers).
2) Day 3–9: automated benchmarks (NER F1, intent accuracy, hallucination checklist) + human eval sample of 300 prompts.
3) Day 10–12: perform targeted tuning (prompt engineering, cache warmups).
4) Day 13–14: produce parity report with recommended rollout plan and estimated costs.

Risks to flag:
- Narrow-domain terminology: open models sometimes drop domain-specific entity normalization; we'll measure entity mapping deltas.
- Answer style/regulatory compliance: differences in recommended phrasing for regulated responses — we can add style filters if needed.

Proposed next step: I’ll loop Priyom and Marissa to scope infra and benchmarks, then we set a pilot kickoff for next Wednesday (Aug 4) if that works.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-27T09:14:00Z
Subject: Internal: quick infra + bench recs for Finova trial

Internal notes — copying here so we have a record to send to Finova.

- Suggested infra: start with g5.12x (or equivalent A100 40GB) for Mistral-34B q4_0; scale to g5.24x for Llama-2-70B if we need to hit throughput. For Falcon-180B, propose a dedicated A100-80GB pool and Q8_0 quantization; cost will be materially higher.
- Batching strategy: continuous small micro-batches (size 2–4) with KV cache warmups during the early ramp will reduce p95 by ~15–20%.
- Metrics dashboard: create a per-prompt trace (token-level cost + latency) and human-eval tagging fields. Use our shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-finova-eval
- Prompt bundle: ask Finova for both the full 2k set and a separate 30-item critical set; convert to JSONL with expected label fields.

Attachments to provide to Finova for kickoff: pilot-MAP-prompt-bundle.jsonl, redwood-benchmark-results-0707.pdf (baseline examples).

Priyom
Infra Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@finova.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@finova.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-28T16:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery: model fit needs and baseline metrics

Thanks — a couple clarifications before we kick off: 
1) For FinovaNLP-v3 baseline: we can provide golden answers for the 2k set but not raw inference logs. Does that suffice for your baseline runs?
2) On latency: the 150ms p95 target is a hard requirement for customer-facing queries. If Llama-2-70B is borderline, can you scope an acceptable fallback plan (e.g., use Mistral as default, Llama for a canary of complex prompts)?

Also confirming Aug 4 kickoff is fine — we'll aim to share the redacted 2k by end of day Jul 30.

—Jamie

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@finova.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery: model fit needs and baseline metrics

Jamie — perfect, thanks for the confirmations. Finalized plan and asks below; I've also attached the pilot prompt bundle and a short acceptance checklist.

Action items we’ll execute on kickoff (Aug 4):
- You: share the 2k redacted prompt set + golden answers (CSV/JSONL) and the 30 high-risk prompts (deadline: Jul 30).
- Redwood: provision infra for Mistral-34B (q4_0) and a canary Llama-2-70B profile; run baseline comparisons against your golden answers and produce NER F1 / intent accuracy and hallucination counts within the 2-week sprint.
- Human eval: we'll run a 300-sample blind human evaluation and surface delta vs FinovaNLP-v3.
- Fallback policy: we recommend default routing to Mistral-34B for low-latency paths and Llama-2-70B for canary high-complexity prompts. If Llama underperforms on latency, we will flag and either further quantize or remove from the live route.

Deliverables: pilot parity report (metrics + cost estimates), example prompt engineering patches, rollout recommendation and an SLA-risk memo if we identify compliance wording issues.

Links and attachments: pilot-MAP-prompt-bundle.jsonl (attached), redwood-benchmark-results-0707.pdf (example), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/FIN-2027-045

If that aligns, I’ll put a calendar invite for Aug 4 10am PT and include a short agenda.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot-MAP-prompt-bundle.jsonl (jsonl), redwood-benchmark-results-0707.pdf (pdf)
